goal: Learning Flow 2.0 — meaningful learning + automatic assessment. New CER_CHOICE activity type (structured Claim→Evidence→Reasoning, admin-authored answer keys) replacing mandatory free-text CER; graded mode for EVIDENCE_SELECT (acceptedEvidenceIds) and REASONING_CONNECT (expectedRelations); output continuity via priorOutputs (no re-selecting same evidence); REFLECTION optional+ungraded; separate progress vs knowledge score; admin authoring for graded activities; Flutter CER_CHOICE renderer; Bạch Đằng 938 flow on NEW draft/version + 2nd fixture for engine reuse. acceptanceCriteria.text: No mandatory free-text conclusion in the new flow; conclusion uses CER_CHOICE (or BA-approved equivalent) with deterministic answer keys.
Admin can author answer keys + feedback for graded activities without writing JSON.
Backend auto-grades correct/incorrect/partial per published rules; no count-only pass, no select-all pass.
Evidence selection has a specific question/purpose; prior selectedEvidenceIds reused downstream (no pointless re-selection).
Reasoning graded on content (expectedRelations/acceptedRelationSets), not just valid syntax.
Hypothesis/Verification consume real prior outputs; Conclusion reuses outputs already collected.
Wrong answers get useful feedback; clear retry/revision policy; no learner soft-lock; no infinite revision loop.
Progress and knowledge score are separate; rewards not duplicated; completion/reward not regressed.
Hidden answer keys never reach learner DTOs (recursive strip in projection + handler output).
Old published LessonVersions + in-flight attempts unchanged; legacy CER/EVIDENCE_SELECT/REASONING_CONNECT semantics preserved.
Admin Preview and Flutter render the new flow compatibly.
Bạch Đằng 938 flow runs end-to-end on a NEW draft/version; second lesson fixture proves engine reuse with no code change.
